description: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized shield with Ψ and the XEDRA logo inside it.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the box and a red LED lights up.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The switch clicks but nothing happens.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the box and the red LED turns off.
